audit.why: 52.37% over 2339 games. A ranged laner you beat by force before two items, and the page already reads that way — level 1 contested, 2-5 yours, 2+ items his.

Spike timings are right. What was missing is that his level-6 bump barely exists in lane — The Culling is 110s and a channel he cannot use while you are on top of him — and that his real spike is two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Lucian ability is named anywhere on the page, and the entire plan rests on 'bait his E dash' without ever saying how long that costs him.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s — by a distance the longest basic-ability cooldown either champion has, and longer than your Shield Vault at 13s down to 9s. Baiting it does not open a window, it opens a window twice as long as your own. Riot also states 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown', so poking him for free while he autos you is actively refunding his escape. That single line changes the whole trade pattern and it was absent. The other decisive number: Piercing Light is 500 range, shorter than Shield Vault's 600, so his main damage spell requires him to stand inside your engage range.
audit.corrected: Lightslinger, Piercing Light, Ardent Blaze, Relentless Pursuit and The Culling all named, with the 16s cooldown, the Lightslinger refund and the 500-vs-600 range comparison written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown windows despite the page telling you to fight 'while it's down'.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit at 16s is the punishable cooldown, and The Culling at 110s is the other. Without the numbers, 'bait the dash then commit' is a slogan.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault is recommended three times as the answer to his poke, with no statement of what it does not cover.
audit.why: It is invulnerable from the front only, and Lucian's whole pattern is dashing past you and shooting from the new angle. Holding it toward where he was is the single most common way this matchup is lost, and the page never says so.

edits.before: Lucian is one of the few ranged tops who can actually contest my opening, so I respect his double-shot passive and don't walk into free Q+W poke for nothing. My W stun is point-and-click, so the moment he steps up to last-hit I can vault on, stun, and empowered-Q him before his E dash is up — but if he holds E, my engage gets blanked and he kites back, so I bait it first. notes: No Lucian ability was named anywhere on this page. The most useful thing added is Relentless Pursuit's actual cost: 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, longer than Pantheon's own Shield Vault, which turns 'bait his dash' from a slogan into a window you can count — paired with Riot's own line that 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown', meaning free autos on you refund his escape. Second useful number: Piercing Light is 500 range against Shield Vault's 600, so his main damage spell forces him inside your engage range. REJECTED THREE MISSING-INTERACTION ENTRIES as flag misfires: _missing-interactions.json claims Lucian 'sustains through chip damage (Lightslinger)' and 'can cancel your Aegis Assault (E) with Lightslinger (P)'. Riot's Lightslinger text reads 'When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next attack...' — heal, shield and immobilise there are trigger CONDITIONS supplied by other champions, not effects Lucian applies. He has no heal and no CC, so neither anti-heal nor a channel cancel belongs on this page and I did not write them.
